surfaces.system_text: Stable instructions and activated control context supplied as system content.
surfaces.messages: Ordered public conversation, tool-call, tool-result, notification, summary, and pointer messages.
surfaces.tools: Provider-neutral native tool definitions supplied through the provider tools field.
surfaces.continuation: JSON-safe opaque provider continuation required to resume a native exchange; never public prompt text.

policy_levels.guaranteed: Normative evaluation requirement. A violation fails the contract.
policy_levels.observed: Behavior visible in the current Runtime but not promised by this ticket.
policy_levels.target: Desired routing or governance that requires a later Runtime owner to implement.

unfinished_native_turn.public_private_boundary: messages retain public call/result blocks; opaque continuation retains private provider state and is represented in evidence only by type, count, hash, and token usage

assets.producer: skill registry and selected SKILL.md renderer
assets.activation: catalog when skills are enabled; full instructions only when explicitly selected or otherwise activated

floor.minimum: name, description, activation state, and source identity for available skills

assets.duplication: one catalog entry per skill; activated body must not also appear in messages

current_behavior.summary: ContextManager renders the available-skill section into the monolithic prompt and may tail-clip the section to a character floor.

assets.activation: when the ledger has entries or the active mode requires todo guidance

floor.minimum: identifier, status, priority, and content for every non-terminal item

assets.duplication: single rendered ledger; history may reference changes but must not copy the current ledger as a second authority

current_behavior.summary: TodoLedger text is appended to the generic memory section and inherits that section's clipping and floor behavior.

floor.minimum: mode, active artifact pointer, write constraint, completion gate, and current plan progress pointer

assets.duplication: system text carries policy and a pointer; the full plan body has one canonical carrier

current_behavior.summary: Plan mode refreshes the prompt prefix with the active plan path and policy; the Runtime does not yet expose this as a separately measured asset.

assets.activation: a compatible current checkpoint exists and resume context is relevant

floor.minimum: checkpoint id, goal, blocker, next step, key-file freshness, and runtime identity

assets.duplication: one active checkpoint rendering; older checkpoints remain artifacts referenced by id

current_behavior.summary: Rendered checkpoint text is appended to the generic memory section and can inherit memory-section clipping.

assets.activation: worker starts, changes state, completes, fails, or has an undrained coordinator notification

floor.minimum: worker id, status, action, summary or result pointer, and notification-drained state

assets.duplication: one coordinator notification per state transition; large result content is replaced by a pointer, not copied

current_behavior.summary: Worker completion is rendered as a task-notification and drained into the coordinator turn; stable structured message placement is not yet guaranteed.

assets.producer: durable memory index and retrieval layer
assets.activation: memory is enabled and the index policy or a relevant durable note is selected

floor.minimum: memory policy, selected source identity, freshness, and content pointer

assets.duplication: index stores pointers and brief descriptions; selected body has one rendered carrier

current_behavior.summary: Durable policy is appended to memory and selected durable notes are mixed into relevant memory, each subject to character budgets.

assets.activation: manual or automatic compaction has summarized older terminal turns

floor.minimum: trigger, covered turn boundary, goal or progress, critical context, and source hash

assets.duplication: compacted source turns are replaced, not retained beside the summary in the active message window

current_behavior.summary: CompactManager replaces older terminal turn groups with a compact_summary history item while keeping recent turns.

assets.producer: artifact, memory, checkpoint, worker, and plan producers
assets.activation: full content is externalized, clipped, stale, too large, or intentionally represented by reference

floor.minimum: pointer kind, target id or path, content hash, freshness, and producer

assets.duplication: reference metadata may accompany a short label; referenced body must not be copied into another surface

current_behavior.summary: Pico uses paths and identifiers in several prompt fragments, but does not yet emit a uniform pointer metadata envelope or resolvability evidence.

evidence_contract.privacy: Do not record opaque reasoning or thinking content; continuation evidence is limited to type, count, hash, and token usage.
